name: Starburst

features.name: Starburst wilds
features.description: Wilds on reels 2–4 expand and trigger a respin, up to three in a row.

review: Starburst is a deliberately low volatility game: frequent small wins, a single expanding-wild respin feature and a 500x cap. It's still useful as a reference point for what "low volatility" actually feels like, and its presentation remains clean and readable.
sources: Provider game sheet / in-game info screen (verify before launch)
author: editorial-team
